description: Coefficient of variation of nearest-neighbour spacing for spiral packing. Lower CV is more uniform.

sweep_130_to_145.note: Golden angle wins by factor ~2.4 over next-best.

convergence.note: Golden CV stays flat with n; arbitrary angles degrade linearly.

interpretation: The golden angle is the global optimum of the packing functional for discrete elements in an expanding space. It is a structural packing constant, not a decorative multiplier.
coverage_parity_link: Even Lucas rungs lose half a power-of-two estate; this is a packing failure analogous to rational angles producing few spokes.
